mem_rule_02.generalized_rule: Whenever an aggregated column (e.g., SUM(profit), AVG(gross_revenue)) is selected with non-aggregated attributes (e.g., region, market_type, category), ensure ALL non-aggregated columns appear in the GROUP BY clause.
